title: Visual stimulus decoding across learning phases

titles: Cortex-wide mouse learning before and after rewarded or reward-free exposure

scientific_question: Can a decoder trained only on prereward animals and phases identify the predeclared visual stimulus classes from calcium-derived regional activity in held-out animals after reward-free or rewarded exposure, beyond movement and position?
primary_outputs: Canonical visual stimulus category0–6 mapped explicitly from source UniqWalls/stim_id and held privately for each complete trial/position packet; the plan freezes a subset before outcomes.

data_manifest.file_count_scope: Top-level published assets, including code/docs where packaged together; not a participant count.

recording_contract.neural: utils.load_spk opens {mname}_{datexp}_{blk}_neural_data.npy, concatenating the spks arrays into neurons × frames; these are calcium-derived activity estimates, not electrode spikes. Transform files map neurons into cortical areas.
recording_contract.labels: Beh_{experiment}.npy provides ft_WallID (stimulus), ft_trInd (trial), ft_move, ft_PosCum, ft_CorrSpc and ft_GraySpc, plus licking/reward fields. Imaging_Exp_info.npy identifies supervised/unsupervised/naive and before/after/test experiments.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Neural/behavior correspondence is explicitly frame-indexed: code truncates behavior vectors to nfr and optionally interpolates moving trials into 60 position bins over the corridor. Absolute sampling-time fields were not established; initial tasks use trial/frame/position coordinates, not exact millisecond latencies.
recording_contract.biological_ids: Imaging_Exp_info records mname,datexp,blk; identical IDs occur in neural filenames and behavior keys. Preserve every date/block of one mname. Exact animal counts and cross-session cell correspondences are not independently loaded.
recording_contract.evidence: 297-file Figshare v2 manifest and pinned data_process_script.ipynb/utils.py directly establish neural/behavior filenames and keys. No NPY objects were loaded.

missing_or_unverified: This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: Public item_id plus four calcium regional means (V1 area8; mHV0/1/2/9; lHV5/6; aHV3/4), and matched mean movement/normalized position context.

Source decoded spks and behavior are prepared operator-side; trial-local moving-corridor frames are averaged into every frozen normalized-position bin without extrapolation or neighboring-trial borrowing.
Labels from training animals/phases only; training mouse/class weights equalized.
forbidden_inputs: Query WallID, stim_id, phase, animal/date/block, reward/licking, target labels or target-bearing source filenames.
Query-fitted normalization, feature selection or interpolation across trial boundaries.

allowed_inputs.split: Plan requires train/evaluation animals and phase labels disjoint, with operator-verified prereward training semantics. Whole trials must cover every position bin and every retained mouse/phase must support every frozen class.
allowed_inputs.coverage: Completeness is relative to supplied frozen manifest; exact native animal/session inventory and safe-export equality remain unverified. Class/position subsets are declared construction choices, not extra benchmarks.

primary.name: Mouse-macro stimulus log loss by exposure phase
primary.aggregation: Packet log loss averaged within mouse/phase then equal mice; no scalar averaging across unlike phases. Equal bins per complete trial retain equal trial weight.
primary.rationale: Proper probability scoring against recorded stimulus identity captures calibrated decoding; source figure reproduction is irrelevant to correctness.

secondary: Mouse-macro class-balanced accuracy by phase; class-support counts and constant/zero-probability diagnostics.
Paired neural-minus-movement/position log loss and accuracy, with same expected IDs/labels/class ordering.

comparators.name: Frozen diagonal-Gaussian neural classifier
comparators.inputs: Four regional means and training targets only.
comparators.procedure: Implemented train-only scaling, uniform class priors, mouse/class-balanced centroids and within-class diagonal variance floor0.1.

comparators.name: Matched movement-position classifier
comparators.inputs: Only mean framewise movement and mean normalized position.
comparators.procedure: Identical diagonal-Gaussian fitting and probability output; isolates observed behavioral-context shortcuts.

comparators.name: Uniform probabilities
comparators.procedure: Prospective explicit chance/calibration reference; constant output remains valid and is flagged.

nuisance_controls: Never equate raw WallID values with canonical category numbers; preserve string/integer wall identity mapping.
Require within-trial ft_Pos/Corridor_Length units and four-region anatomical support; regional pooling is a declared cross-animal calibration, not cell registration.
Record every trial exclusion and behavior-tail truncation; freeze eligibility and class support before outcomes.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired2000 seeded mouse-cluster bootstrap within phase; apply identical resamples to both arms. One mouse is descriptive without population interval. Sessions/bins are not independent animals.
evaluation.failure_policy: Reject missing/duplicate/extra IDs, class-shape mismatch, nonfinite or invalid simplex outputs; true-class log probabilities clip at1e-15 with zero counts reported. Reject incomplete class support and malformed alignment rather than shrinking class set.
